name: Aryan Share & Stock Brokers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Aryan Share & Stock Brokers Ltd is in the business of providing stockbroking services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) Core services: 
Stock broking, derivatives trading, and depository services.
b) Client access:
Online trading platform with integrated banking 
convenience; accessible anytime, anywhere.
c) Channel support: 
Associates receive online trading access, 
back-office tools, and full depository backup.
d) Packages: 
Custom pricing for Equity F&O; no upfront fees, targets, or turnover commitments.
e) Brokerage terms: 
Competitive sharing ratios; charges as low
 as ₹1,000 per crore in select packages.
f) Partner network:
 Actively seeks sub-brokers, branches, 
and remisiers for wealth creation initiatives.
g) Connectivity & training: 
V-SAT, broadband, leased line VPN; and a team forthe training and updates.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.40 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -8.63% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.66% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -4.13%
